title: Photos.sqlite
timeNote: ZDATECREATED, ZMODIFICATIONDATE och ZADDEDDATE är normalt Apple Cocoa-tid (sekunder sedan 2001-01-01 UTC). Mallarna konverterar med +978307200 → unixepoch. Verifiera mot Time Converter vid behov.
generalCaveats: Scheman ändras mellan iOS-versioner — kör alltid 'Schema-probe' mot din DB först.
Kolumn-/FK-namn (t.ex. ZASSET vs ZGENERICASSET) kan skilja sig; prova närmaste versionsband.
Queries är hypotesstöd, inte bevis. Attribution: mönster i linje med iLEAPP/DFIR-praxis — anpassa efter din dump.
Bundle-ID (ZCREATORBUNDLEID / ZEDITORBUNDLEID) indikerar ofta källapp/importväg, men kan saknas eller vara generisk.

queries.title: Schema-probe (tabeller)
queries.caveats: Lista tabellnamn så du ser om ZGENERICASSET / ZASSET finns.
queries.sql: SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name LIKE 'Z%' ORDER BY name;

queries.title: Schema-probe (kolumner asset)
queries.caveats: Byt tabellnamn om probe visar ZASSET istället för ZGENERICASSET.
queries.sql:
PRAGMA table_info(ZGENERICASSET);
PRAGMA table_info(ZADDITIONALASSETATTRIBUTES);

queries.title: Sök via filnamn (app + tider)
queries.caveats: Partial match. Om JOIN misslyckas: kontrollera FK-kolumn (ZASSET).
queries.sql:
SELECT
  a.Z_PK AS asset_pk,
  a.ZDIRECTORY,
  a.ZFILENAME,
  datetime(a.ZDATECREATED + 978307200, 'unixepoch') AS date_created_utc,
  datetime(a.ZMODIFICATIONDATE + 978307200, 'unixepoch') AS modification_utc,
  datetime(a.ZADDEDDATE + 978307200, 'unixepoch') AS added_utc,
  a.ZDATECREATED AS cocoa_created,
  a.ZMODIFICATIONDATE AS cocoa_modified,
  a.ZADDEDDATE AS cocoa_added,
  aa.ZORIGINALFILENAME,
  aa.ZCREATORBUNDLEID,
  aa.ZEDITORBUNDLEID,
  aa.ZEXIFTIMESTAMPSTRING
FROM ZGENERICASSET a
LEFT JOIN ZADDITIONALASSETATTRIBUTES aa ON aa.ZASSET = a.Z_PK
WHERE a.ZFILENAME LIKE '%{{filename}}%'
   OR IFNULL(aa.ZORIGINALFILENAME, '') LIKE '%{{filename}}%'
ORDER BY a.ZADDEDDATE DESC;

queries.title: Senast tillagda (med skapar-app)
queries.caveats: Begränsad till 200 rader. Bra överblick innan filnamnssök.
queries.sql:

  a.Z_PK AS asset_pk,
  a.ZDIRECTORY,
  a.ZFILENAME,
  datetime(a.ZADDEDDATE + 978307200, 'unixepoch') AS added_utc,
  datetime(a.ZDATECREATED + 978307200, 'unixepoch') AS date_created_utc,
  aa.ZCREATORBUNDLEID,
  aa.ZEDITORBUNDLEID,
  aa.ZORIGINALFILENAME
FROM ZGENERICASSET a
LEFT JOIN ZADDITIONALASSETATTRIBUTES aa ON aa.ZASSET = a.Z_PK
